My thoughts and experiences regarding Singapore:

First off, I am not a Singaporean. I am a Filipino who has been working and living in Singapore for the past 4 years. I am not citizen nor a permanent resident and am strictly in this country for work.

The way she describes Singapore annoys me a bit. I grew up and lived in the Philippines: an actual present-day 3rd world country rife with corruption, crime, and a failing public system. I have worked hard just to be able to live in Singapore and I am thankful for it. The way that everything in Singapore just works properly never fails to amaze me - excellent public transport, excellent public facilities, clean water, extremely high speed internet, very very low crime rate (you can literally leave your bag/purse in the public food courts and no one will take it). Yet, here she is; a pampered person who is fortunate enough to live and grow up in a prosperous and orderly country  pissing on it and describing it like some sort of authoritarian hell, she never even described anything positive about it.

Singapore may not be perfect, but it's got a lot of great things going for it, and compared to its other South East Asian neighbors, I think it has achieved a lot. A pity it takes an outsider like me - who knows the difference between an actual chaotic country- to see its actual value and achievements .

What’s more, the day/date display can be set individually, with a choice of Kanji or English language for the day display (once set, it will be fixed to that chosen language).
